subtitle: 把资料切成能指回原文的片段，并从加载起就当作数据

exercises.title: 两组分块参数：片段目录与跨段查询

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：加载固定语料，分别用默认参数和窄参数分块，逐个片段对回原文件，并检查两条跨段查询的证据能否落在同一个片段里。
question.en: No model call: load the fixed corpus, chunk it with the default and the narrow preset, check every chunk against the original file, and see whether the evidence for two cross-section queries fits in a single chunk.

exercises.title: 加载异常：空文档、重复与解析失败

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：把问题文件和正常语料一起加载，记录每个异常，并核对没有文件被悄悄跳过。
question.en: No model call: load the problem files together with the clean corpus, record every issue, and confirm that no file was skipped silently.

exercises.title: 信任边界：资料里的伪装指令

question.zh-CN: 把逾期费用规定和一条伪装成指令的读者留言交给模型，问两次“逾期费用每册最高多少？”：一次资料混在指令里，一次资料加标签并声明不可信，比较模型的实际回答。
question.en: Give the model the overdue rule and a reader comment that poses as an instruction, and ask "What is the maximum overdue charge per item?" twice: once with the material mixed into the instructions, once tagged and declared untrusted. Compare the model's actual replies.

ui.question_help: 三个练习的语料和问题都是固定的；这里的文字只作备注，不会发给模型。
